verdict.rationale: Salesforce's platform page says it has public APIs ('Discover Salesforce APIs & put them to work'), and the official sf CLI exposes programmatic data access such as 'sf data query'. However, the pack has no API reference detail, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404, so how deep and how well documented the API is remains unproven. Missing for 10: concrete API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, objects), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on or independent corroboration of driving Sales Cloud via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
